title: Would YOU click that? Please rate covers for my robot platformer (½–5 stars)
author: CreativeProblem7803
selftext:
Hi all! I'm making a 3D action platformer for the browser: you play a robot with an arm cannon, fighting your way through ten robot-boss sectors.

The cover is the first thing anyone sees on a game portal, usually as a thumbnail about 250 px wide between forty other games, so I want to pick the one that actually gets clicked, not just the one I like. I've got ten candidates and I'd love your honest take.

**Please Rate** each one from **½ to 5 stars** here (takes about a minute, no sign-up): 👉 [https://konstantinsteinmiller.github.io/mega-droid/cover-vote/](https://konstantinsteinmiller.github.io/mega-droid/cover-vote/)

You'll see the overall community ranking as soon as you've rated all of them.

***Please ignore the inconsistencies*** *in the Player robot designs These are just mood board covers and will be finalised after the voting.*

What I'm asking you to judge, for each cover:

* **Appeal**: does it look good and fun?
* **Clickability**: would it make you want to click and play?

If you'd rather answer here, a comment like `A 4, B 2.5, C 5 …` works too. And I'd especially love to hear *why* your favourite and your least favourite stand out: is it the character, the colours, the boss, how readable it is small?

Thanks a lot. I'll post the results once enough votes are in!
